name: Gulf Development Public Company Limited
summary: Gulf Development Public Company Limited generates and sells electricity and steam to public and private clients in Thailand and internationally. The company operates through Power Business, Consulting Business, Infrastructure Business and Satellite and Digital Business segments. It generates electricity through gas-fired, solar, biomass hydroelectric, waste-to-energy, and wind power projects under independent power producers and small power producers. The company undertakes infrastructure and logistics projects; distributes, supplies, and sells natural gas; and operates a digital infrastructure.
